notes: «وبهذا الاسناد» takes the whole chain of report 3 (prev1): the six names are inherited in order, the Imam last.
The gap «من» in prev1 is an unnamed informant there; it is carried as written, not filled.
The saying's words name the Imam («كان الصادق جعفر بن محمد يقول») who is already the last inherited link: not written twice.
The report has no own transmitter after «وبهذا الاسناد».
